_about: M2 and M4: a project that installed two APM packages. The checks write these files into a temp folder, deploy campus-standards from vendor/, and compute apm.lock.yaml.

files.apm.yml:
name: campus-app
version: 1.0.0
description: A course app on the university's shared harness
dependencies:
  apm:
    - microsoft/apm-sample-package#v1.0.0
    - studybuddy-org/campus-standards#v1.4.0
